verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for CrewAI, since it offers a managed AMP deployment platform as well as an open-source framework. However, nothing in the pack covers region selection, residency controls, or where memory, knowledge or deployment data is stored. The managed-infrastructure docs ([crewai-docs-14], [crewai-docs-55]) never mention regions, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.
